summary: Frontend regression on unified FilterBar + ListPagination across /invoices, /quotes, /customers, /suppliers, /products, /expenses AND 5 PDF templates for invoice a752e9ca. RESULT: all functional requirements pass. Filter bars render (data-testid=filter-bar) with search + date-range (only on invoices/quotes/expenses as spec) + presets Μήνας/Προηγ./Τρίμηνο/Έτος + status chips + Καθαρισμός link; preset-month sets ?from=2026-09-01&to=2026-09-30 and requestSubmit()s the form; page-size-50 preserves from/to in URL (?from=…&to=…&page=1&pageSize=50); chip click navigates and applies active state; search 'ΔΟΚΙΜΗ' on /customers filters 12→2 rows. Pagination range 'X–Y από Z' shown via data-testid=pagination-range (e.g. '1–20 από 20 παραστατικά'). No horizontal overflow at 1920x900 or 390x844 on all 6 business pages + /office/inbox, /office/cockpit, /office/alerts (scrollWidth == innerWidth). PDF templates: /settings?tab=appearance shows all 5 cards (Κλασικό, Μοντέρνο, Μινιμαλ, Έντονο, Κομψό); selecting each + Αποθήκευση + GET /api/invoices/<id>/pdf via browser session returns HTTP 200 application/pdf with FIVE DISTINCT byte sequences (sizes 28483/28701/28899/29066/29337; sha256 all different). pdfinfo confirms every PDF is A4 595.28x841.89 pts, single page. Invoice on-screen preview article[data-template] reflects selected id (classic/modern/minimal/bold/elegant) and has min-height 1122.52px (≈297mm @96dpi). Template restored to 'modern' at end.
testid_naming_mismatches_with_review_spe: spec 'date-range-placeholder' → NOT PRESENT; DateRangeFields uses native <input type=date>. Visual '—' separator is shown but there is no element with data-testid=date-range-placeholder and the literal string 'από — έως' is only in a JSDoc comment, not rendered. Empty inputs simply render the browser's native date placeholder (dd/mm/yyyy).
spec 'pagination-size-<n>' → actual 'page-size-<n>' (25/50/100/200 all present and functional)

template selector buttons on /settings?tab=appearance have NO data-testid; only aria-pressed toggles. A stable testid like pdf-template-<id> (classic/modern/minimal/bold/elegant) would make regression tests robust.
verified_working: DateRangeFields present on invoices/quotes/expenses (data-testid=date-range-fields) — absent on customers/suppliers/products which matches the spec
Status chip click sets .bg-foreground active state and appends ?status=draft (verified on /invoices)
filter-clear link present when filters active; filter-submit works
pagination-range text: '1–20 από 20 παραστατικά', '1–1 από 1 προσφορές', '1–12 από 12 πελάτες', '1–3 από 3 προμηθευτές', '1–13 από 13 είδη', '1–5 από 5 έξοδα'
No horizontal overflow at 1920x900 and 390x844 on invoices/quotes/customers/suppliers/products/expenses AND /office/inbox|cockpit|alerts
All 5 saved templates produce distinct PDFs (unique SHA-256, sizes 28.4–29.3 KB): classic b711a073…, modern e4f968ed…, minimal 358da521…, bold cff68dc0…, elegant b34ddf83…
pdfinfo on all 5 files: Page size 595.28 x 841.89 pts (A4), 1 page
/invoices/a752e9ca... on-screen preview: article[data-template]=<selected id> and computed min-height 1122.52px (≈297mm at 96dpi)
Template restored to 'modern' at the end of the run
action_items: OPTIONAL / SPEC-COMPLIANCE: rename data-testids to match the review spec so external test suites match — filter-q→filter-search, chip-→filter-chip-, page-size-→pagination-size-, page-prev/next→pagination-prev/next. Add a visible 'από — έως' overlay shown when both from and to are empty (currently only a '—' separator between two native date inputs, no 'από — έως' string is ever rendered).
OPTIONAL: add data-testid='pdf-template-<id>' (classic|modern|minimal|bold|elegant) to template selector buttons in appearance-panel.tsx for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: list/filter-bar.tsx and list/list-pagination.tsx are clean, small server components sharing state via URL — no duplication across the 6 pages. Good.

DateRangeFields relies on native <input type=date>; there is no rendered 'από — έως' placeholder despite being called out in the review request. Consider a wrapping div with data-testid=date-range-placeholder that is visible only when !f && !t and hidden otherwise (pointer-events: none over the native inputs).
PDF theme system (lib/pdf/theme.ts + invoice-pdf.tsx) produces genuinely distinct outputs per template (verified by sha256 and byte size); A4 MediaBox is honored on all 5 templates.
Template selector buttons lack data-testid, forcing tests to fall back to fragile aria-pressed+text matching.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; testid names diverge from review spec but every behavior verified

seed_data_creation: None. Only setting toggled was organizations.pdfThemeJson (cycled through 5 templates and restored to 'modern').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter/pagination/PDF-templates feature is functionally complete. If main agent renames the testids to match spec (filter-search, filter-chip-*, pagination-size-*, pagination-prev/next, date-range-placeholder, pdf-template-*), next testing agent can rerun with those exact selectors. PDF byte-identity comparison across templates is the strongest signal that templates truly differ (not just visual chrome).
